status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Particles
summary: A quiet constellation gives the interface room to breathe.
use_when: Use for technology explainers, discovery pages, and ambient learning hubs.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: System sans-serif with open heading spacing.
layout: Stable foreground panels over a sparse constellation.
surfaces: Small decorative dots and fine connecting lines behind opaque panels.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Particles to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with open heading spacing. Stable foreground panels over a sparse constellation. Small decorative dots and fine connecting lines behind opaque panels. Palette: background #0a1630, surface #122747, text #edf5ff, muted #b5cbe3, accent #a2d5ff, border #4d6d91. Essential traits: Sparse background particles; Large quiet reading zones; Optional slow ambient motion. Avoid: Particles over text; Distracting density; Random movement required for navigation. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
